tool.help:
**Result Heatmap Tool**
This tool generates a heatmap visualization from TSV data containing classification results. n interactive heatmap visualization from TSV data containing classification results.
**Parameters:**
- **Input TSV File**: Tab-separated values file with classification results data. Must have a 'name' column as index. - **Column Indices (Optional)**: Comma-separated indices of rows to include in the plot (e.g., 1,6,11,16,21). Leave empty to plot all data rows. - **Figure Width**: Width of the output figure in pixels (default: 2460) - **Figure Height**: Height of the output figure in pixels (default: 800) - **Color Palette**: Plotly color scheme for the heatmap (e.g., Greens, Blues, Reds, emrld, Viridis) - **Font Size**: Size of text displayed in the heatmap cells (default: 22) - **Tick Font Size**: Size of axis labels (default: 26) - **Tick Angle**: Rotation angle of x-axis labels in degrees (e.g., -80 for bottom-right diagonal) - **Threshold**: Threshold value used for comparison analysis (default: 0.05)
**Output:**
An interactive HTML heatmap that can be viewed in a web browser.
**Workflow:**
1. Read the input TSV file with 'name' column and classification results 2. Analyze classification performance by comparing values 3. Categorize columns based on comparison thresholds 4. Generate an interactive heatmap visualization with color-coded highlights
**Example Usage:**
Plot all data with default parameters or specify custom dimensions and color scheme for customized visualizations.
